page: Microsoft Azure L64ps_v5 is a storage-optimized virtual machine built on the 64-bit ARM architecture. Managed under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, the instance provides 64 dedicated vCPUs along with 512.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8.0 GB per vCPU allocation ratio. It does not include dedicated graphics processing units, centering its design entirely on compute, memory, and high-capacity local disk IO.

A key differentiator of the L64ps_v5 is its direct integration of 15,360 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage. The combination of dense ARM core scaling and massive local NVMe capacity eliminates remote disk network latency bottlenecks for high-throughput reads and writes. Additionally, the instance supports Premium Storage configurations for workloads requiring complementary managed disks.

The 1:8 core-to-memory ratio paired with substantial physical NVMe capacity makes the server economically advantageous for high-density transactional databases, distributed file systems, real-time analytics engines, and large-scale NoSQL data stores like Apache Cassandra or MongoDB where fast ephemeral storage and high memory caching directly reduce total operational overhead.
